##### Project general facts

Park Boulevard by Meteora is a beautifully sculptural residential tower, rising as ground plus a four-storey podium and fourteen residential floors, with softly curved balconies and integrated planters that let greenery cascade down the facade. It is home to 138 residences across a well-judged mix of studios, one bedroom and two bedroom apartments, with just eight to ten homes per floor to keep the building feeling private and unhurried. Conceived as a sustainable, green oasis, the tower pairs cutting-edge design with genuine environmental commitment through energy-efficient features, lush planting and innovative technology.

Residents are exceptionally well served, with separate swimming pools for adults and children, a fully equipped gym, a dedicated children's play area and an outdoor movie theatre for evenings under the stars. A dedicated retail level brings genuine everyday convenience right downstairs, with supermarkets, a pharmacy and a cafe, alongside a doctor-on-call service and a concierge team looking after residents. Thoughtful extras round out the offering beautifully, including a dedicated pets area, electric vehicle charging bays and an air-purified building for cleaner air throughout.

The interiors follow a calm, aesthetic and distinctly modern direction, built around a warm neutral palette of stone and travertine surfaces paired with soft timber joinery and gentle arched detailing. Every apartment comes with a fully fitted kitchen complete with integrated appliances, along with smart home technology woven throughout for effortless everyday control of the home. Oversized floor-to-ceiling glazing draws light deep into the living spaces, while the bathrooms are finished with full-height stone surfaces, recessed niches, backlit mirrors and elegant walk-in showers.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
